scope: Practical integration of fixed GitHub artifact recovery into the existing serialized workflow; no source content certification.
verified_by_reading: Fixed repository, run, artifact ID/name/expiry/size and SHA256 are checked; no arbitrary archive endpoint is accepted.
Workflow supplies GH_TOKEN from github.token; existing actions:write includes the actions:read permission needed for artifact retrieval.
Normal gh api authentication is used; no custom redirected Authorization header is constructed. Official CLI auth transport includes an explicit cross-host redirect guard.

The recovery step runs inside hadith-bank-web-imports with cancel-in-progress false; restore, report, offline rebuild and CLI import use the shared importer lock. The recovery script does not commit, push or dispatch.

The transaction only appends missing immutable Deen snapshots/parsed objects/imported entries after verification. Current errors, blocks, retry receipts, histories and other non-imported state fields remain unchanged.
The first recovery cycle writes and retains the original before-status, performs a fixed zero-request Deen rebuild and shared reviews-only validation, and skips the ordinary public-page batch.

The offline rebuild wrapper preserves an existing source block and exact current state bytes while allowing local derivatives to be validated; it does not accept a generic importer CLI exit code 2 as success.
The existing successful-save continuation compares retained before/after fetched counts, so recovered entries provide a productive-progress signal without source HTTP.
New recovery script and plan paths are included in the workflow push trigger.
Normal git add includes raw/parsed evidence, current state and the durable recovery receipt/index under imports/web-deenhindi-20261112.
A fresh zero-request rebuild and report refresh now run around the rebase review/status refresh and before staging/amending every recovery save attempt.

Report requires exact current state, progress, importer and verified-index rebuild proof hashes; rejects stale review inputs/engine; verifies held rows against exact immutable source data; and replaces generated artifact sets.
Full recovered exact source records and state descriptors are supplied in the compact delta; currently held rows receive their own raw/parsed evidence bundle with a 32 MiB source-payload limit.

findings_resolved.issue: Pre-save held bundle could become stale after rebasing newer reviews.
findings_resolved.resolution: RECOVERY_CHECKPOINT-conditioned offline rebuild and report regeneration after each rebase, with the report after review/status refresh and before git add/amend.

findings_resolved.issue: Bundling all 508 recovered raw snapshots could make the manual-review download unnecessarily large.
findings_resolved.resolution: Separate held-only evidence artifact; compact full-delta JSON records/descriptors; 32 MiB held source-payload cap.

findings_resolved.issue: A stale generated held directory could retain snapshots removed by newer reviews.
findings_resolved.resolution: Generated delta/held directories are replaced as complete sets.

primary_reference_checks.finding: Artifact download accepts GitHub App installation tokens and requires Actions read permission.
GitHub Actions supplies github.token to CLI through GH_TOKEN.
addAuthHeaderRoundTripper does not re-add authentication when a redirect changes hostname.
The API command uses its configured HTTP client for the fixed API route.

remaining_verification: Implementer transaction/replay tests and deployment_audit workflow integration tests are separate validation records.
Actual 674,433,448-byte artifact hash, full restored source bytes, resulting held count and validated save still require the authorized CI run.
